findings.message: Contrast not checked for 4 text element(s) on gradient, image or translucent backgrounds — check those by eye.

With long content (names 2.5 times longer, a 60-character word, 9,999,999): span.stock-count "8 un. 8 un. 8" is clipped by its container div.stock-list — the text is longer than its box. Let it wrap (overflow-wrap: anywhere), truncate it with the full value in a title, or give it more room.
